name: answered-functions
description: Dependency manifest for the Answered Netlify functions. THIS FILE EXISTS BECAUSE THE HOUSE DEPLOY RUNS `npm install` IN THIS DIRECTORY. Without it that step installed nothing, @netlify/blobs was absent from the deployed bundle, the scheduled canary never loaded, and /api/demo-health reported healthy:false site wide, which hid every call control on the live site. Measured on prod 2026-08-14. Do NOT add "type": "module": the .js handlers in this directory (demo-health.js, event.js, interest.js, answered-voice.js, site-directory.js) are CommonJS and would all break at once; the .mjs handlers are ESM by extension and need no help.
